LanguageData.LP_Crystal_ChainLightning.label: arcanum crystal: chain lightning
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_ChainLightning.description: A Mana Lake arcanum crystal (a universal arcanum any class can learn). Absorbing requires adventurer level 11 and Intelligence 15, taking 1 arcanum slot; base absorb success 80%, +5% per point above the requirement. On failure the crystal doesn't shatter, but you suffer arcanum backlash for 3 days and can only retry after 7 days.\n\nUniversal arcanum (circle 6 spell, Intelligence): a bolt of lightning starts at the target and jumps across 4 enemies, each taking 25 electrical damage, ×1.5 against mechanoids. Cooldown 2 days.

LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Wish.label: arcanum crystal: wish
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Wish.description: A Mana Lake arcanum crystal (a universal arcanum any class can learn). LanguageData.LP_SealCrystal_Mending.label: seal crystal: mending
LanguageData.LP_SealCrystal_Mending.description: A Mana Lake seal crystal. After absorbing it (about 1 hour) you permanently learn the lake seal spell "Mending", taking 1 seal spell slot. Adventurer level 1 and Intellectual 4, absorb success 100%; on failure the crystal shatters and the pawn hears lake echoes for 1 day. Liches never fail to absorb.\n\nLake seal (tier 1 spell, Intelligence, lake breath 1): one piece of apparel or weapon recovers 30% durability. When targeting a person, mends the most worn piece on them; you can also target an item on the ground directly.
